'''Harrison's Sneasel''' (Japanese: '''ハヅキのニューラ''' ''Hazuki's Nyula'') is the only {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} {{Jo|Harrison}} was seen to capture.

==History==
[[File:Harrison Sneasel debut.png|thumb|left|200px|Sneasel as a wild Pokémon]]
Sneasel first appeared in ''[[EP265|Pop Goes The Sneasel]]''. It was a [[wild Pokémon]] working alongside a {{p|Machop}} and {{p|Machoke}} that were blocking people from accessing {{p|Ho-Oh}}'s flame kept in the [[Ho-Oh Shrine]] on [[Mt. Silver]]. It threatened {{TRT}}, attacking {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} with {{m|Fury Swipes}} and defeating {{MTR}} in a single hit. It then ordered its cronies to send Team Rocket blasting off. It later attacked {{Ash}} as he reached the temple, and fought his {{AP|Totodile}}, interrupting his dance with a pair of {{m|Slash}} attacks. It dodged Totodile's {{m|Water Gun}}, and used {{m|Feint Attack}}, followed by a {{m|Shadow Ball}}, to knock him out.
[[File:Ash Totodile Harrison Sneasel.png|thumb|left|200px|Sneasel losing to Totodile]]
Team Rocket made a failed attempt to capture Sneasel, but Meowth's bitterness at being replaced as the trio's mascot caused the plan to fall apart and they defeated themselves. {{jo|Harrison}} then ordered his {{TP|Harrison|Blaziken}} into {{pkmn|battle}}. Sneasel proved no match for Blaziken's sheer power and [[type]] advantage, being knocked out with a {{m|Fire Punch}} to the face. Harrison threw a {{i|Poké Ball}} and {{pkmn2|caught}} Sneasel.

Despite being new to his team, Harrison trusted its strength enough to use it in the [[Silver Conference]], where it faced a {{p|Machamp}} and defeated it, despite the significant type disadvantage. 

In ''[[EP271|Playing with Fire!]]'', it fought against [[Ash's Pikachu]] as Harrison's second Pokémon. It easily used its speed to dodge {{m|Thunderbolt}} and took Pikachu out with {{m|Metal Claw}}. It then fought a rematch with Totodile, who learned from Pikachu's mistake and instead {{m|Bite|bit}} down on Metal Claw. He then danced around while thrashing Sneasel against the ground. A powerful blow from Totodile's tail eliminated Sneasel, causing Totodile to dance in celebration.
{{-}}

==Personality and characteristics==
Sneasel first appeared to be a very mischievous, stubborn, and strong Pokémon, as it prevented people from accessing {{p|Ho-Oh}}'s flame, despite the fact that the entire [[Silver Conference]] would stand still without the flame. Nevertheless, it lost its attitude upon capture and turned out to be a very reliable and trustworthy Pokémon, to the effect that Harrison chose it to battle {{Ash}} in the [[Silver Conference]].
